Upgrading to a new phone often comes with a hidden cost: when the new and old iPhones have different dimensions, you need to buy a separate case.

For users upgrading from last year's Pro model to the iPhone 18 Pro, buying a new case is almost unavoidable — but two accessory makers disagree on this, and one of them is betting big on this prediction...

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman posted a photo of an Otterbox case on Twitter, saying the product is already on sale at Best Buy and is compatible with both the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro. The bottom-right corner of the packaging is marked in English and French:

Compatible with iPhone 18 Pro iPhone 17 Pro

Gurman himself is not entirely convinced either, adding "a bit early." However, Matt Ronge of Astropad (which specialises in anti-glare screen protectors for iPhones) said his suppliers have told him the same thing.

Conflicting rumours on the thickness of the iPhone Pro

Last year, leakers pointed out that at least the iPhone 18 Pro Max would be thicker and heavier than its predecessor. The reports did not mention the smaller Pro model, but information from iPhone suppliers indicates that the iPhone 18 Pro will be two millimetres thicker than its predecessor.

This trend appears to be continuing, as both iPhone 17 Pro models are thicker and heavier than their predecessors.

However, not all leakers share the same view — some say the iPhone 18 Pro Max will be exactly the same thickness as last year's model.

9to5Mac's take

Apple does sometimes provide dimensional information to partner case manufacturers in advance so that third-party cases can launch alongside new iPhones. On the other hand, accessory makers have been known to place production orders based purely on rumours, and sometimes they get it wrong. Personally, I wouldn't buy a case before the new iPhone is officially announced.
